what: Evaluation of Tidepool for the Ferry deposit/status flow
label: community testnet, not 1Click
service: https://www.usetidepool.tech (community-operated; its docs say it is not affiliated with NEAR, Defuse or 1Click)

code_hash_check.how: view_account code_hash (base58 -> hex) compared with sha256sum of defuse.wasm downloaded from the release; also equals the release's defuse.sha256 file

caveats: verifier.tidepool-sandbox.testnet has 1 full-access key, so its operator can redeploy it; recheck the code hash before each use
One maker (maker.tidepool-sandbox.testnet) fills every quote, and it derives deposit-address keys on its server, so deposit addresses are custodial (testnet tokens only)
Quote signatures are Tidepool's maker key, not 1Click's
NEAR testnet tokens only (blockchain near); no Zcash, no Base Sepolia yet (roadmap)
decision: Usable for a testnet deposit -> status -> refund demo of the Ferry flow, always labelled 'community testnet, not 1Click'. Live Ferry quotes keep using real 1Click in dry mode. Not integrated yet.
